name: Lucy Loud
source:
Lucy came after [url=https://vndb.org/c151341]I[/url] did, you'd think my parents would have been finished after they finally got a boy… but Nope, they kept making babies! I'm not complaining, I love all my younger sisters!

Lucy is a goth girl, and I mean old school goth girl! She loves vampires, graveyards, the occult and supernatural, as well as the color black. Lucy is a passionate soul who writes poetry when she's not hanging out with her Mortician's Club, or conjuring up the recently departed!

Despite her gloomy exterior her inner world is deep and full of emotion! Privacy is already at a premium in the Loud House, but you can never really be sure you're alone because of Lucy!

She has the unnerving habit of just appearing as if out of thin air! Who knows how long she might have been secretly watching you!

Lucy has one secret only I'm privy to. She's got a secret girly side and absolutely loves that pony show lots of grown men are also interested in (I think [url=https://vndb.org/c151343]Clyde[/url] secretly watches it too)

I once had to claim one of her books was mine so she wouldn't ruin her reputation in front of the rest of the family! That's okay though, Lucy is usually on my side, and it's better to have her as an ally than an opponent!

Her catch phrase is "[i]Siiiigh[/i]".

[In game description]
